segments.heading: The one line: checksum of go2.sh
segments.text:
Checksum of `go2.sh`, the script of control I.
- The line holds the sha256 of the file content as 64 hexadecimal digits, then two spaces, then the file name. This is the output format of the tool `sha256sum`.
- build_facts.py tests the local copy of go2.sh against this value in check 20 of the facts sheet [Ref1].
- The session record holds a test of the copy on CRB. The command that copied go2.sh to CRB ran `sha256sum -c go2.sha` there. It printed `go2.sh: OK` about 5 s before go2.sh was started [Ref6].
